Card Q&A.a: No, Security Digimon aren't considered to be Digimon, so this Tamer's effect doesn't activate.
Card Q&A.q: My green or blue Digimon deletes an opponent's Security Digimon in battle and survives. Can I suspend this Tamer to gain a memory?

Card Q&A.a: Your green Digimon or your blue Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: What cards can be deleted by this card's [Your Turn] effect?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 memory or less, set your memory to 3.
[Your Turn] When one of your green or blue Digimon deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle and survives, you may suspend this Tamer to gain 1 memory.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
